<!-- OUR STORY — war-interrupted, called back        -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background: #0B1F3B; padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem; color: #FFFFFF;">
  <div class="home-story-grid" style="max-width: 1140px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr; gap: 3.5rem; align-items: center;">
    <div>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #D4A017; margin: 0 0 0.7rem;">Our Story</p>
      <h2 style="font-family: Playfair Display, serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.35rem); font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; line-height: 1.2;">Interrupted by War. Called Back by Hope.</h2>
      <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.6rem;"></div>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); line-height: 1.8; font-size: 0.98rem; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">Since 2006, Y.E.T. Compassion has served the people of South Sudan — drilling wells, delivering food aid and medical supplies, and supporting schools in the Biong community.</p>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); line-height: 1.8; font-size: 0.98rem; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">When war broke out in 2013, families were displaced and the work on the ground had to stop. Today, conditions have opened the door to return — and we are resuming the mission where it matters most: educating the next generation.</p>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 1.8rem;">
        <span style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: #122D52; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 99px; padding: 0.45rem 1rem;"><b style="color: #D4A017;">2006</b> &nbsp;Ministry founded</span>
        <span style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: #122D52; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 99px; padding: 0.45rem 1rem;"><b style="color: #D4A017;">2006–2013</b> &nbsp;Wells, food aid &amp; schools in Biong</span>
        <span style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: #122D52; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 99px; padding: 0.45rem 1rem;"><b style="color: #D4A017;">2013</b> &nbsp;War halts the work</span>
        <span style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: #122D52; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 99px; padding: 0.45rem 1rem;"><b style="color: #D4A017;">Today</b> &nbsp;Building a school in Juba</span>
      </div>
      <a href="/about/index.qmd" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #D4A017; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #D4A017; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms ease; min-height: 48px;">Read the Full Story →</a>

<!-- Homepage-specific responsive + live thermometer -->
<style>
  @media (max-width: 860px) {
    .home-campaign-grid, .home-pillar-grid, .home-story-grid, .home-live-grid, .home-give-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
    .home-stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important; }
  }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  const GOAL = 100000;
  const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  const raisedEl = document.getElementById('home-campaign-raised');
  const barEl    = document.getElementById('home-campaign-bar');
  const pctEl    = document.getElementById('home-campaign-pct');
  const donorsEl = document.getElementById('home-campaign-donors');
  if (!raisedEl) return;
  fetch('/.netlify/functions/campaign-progress?campaign=2026', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('unavailable'); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
      const raised = Number(data.raised) || 0;
      const donors = Number(data.donors) || 0;
      const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((raised / GOAL) * 100));
      raisedEl.textContent = fmt.format(raised);
      barEl.style.width = pct + '%';
      pctEl.textContent = pct + '% funded';
      donorsEl.textContent = donors ? donors + ' donors' : '';
      const track = barEl.parentElement;
      if (track) track.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(raised));
    })
    .catch(function () {
      pctEl.textContent = 'Live total loading…';
      donorsEl.textContent = '';
    });
})();
</script>
